text: Neither the sun nor death can be looked at steadily.
author: François de La Rochefoucauld
visual_brief: An engineering cross-section of an optical coronagraph or eclipse telescope, showing a dark central occulting disc suspended along an optical axis to block direct rays from an overwhelming light source. Clean white technical linework on black displays ray paths diverging around the perimeter, lens elements in cross-hatch, and calibration tick marks along the tube.
alt: Engineering cross-section of a coronagraph with an occulting disc blocking direct rays
